local function JSXEYO_script() 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Frame)

	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	
	local gui = script.Parent
	
	local dragging
	local dragInput
	local dragStart
	local startPos
	
	local function update(input)
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
	
	gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = gui.Position
			
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragging then
			update(input)
		end
	end)
end

	local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local originalColor = button.BackgroundColor3
	local activeColor = Color3.new(0.341176, 0.45098, 0.294118)
	
	local isFlying = false
	local flightConnection = nil
	local originalTransparency = {}
	
	local function saveTransparency()
		originalTransparency = {}
		for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				originalTransparency[part] = part.Transparency
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function setTransparency(value)
		for part, _ in pairs(originalTransparency) do
			if part and part.Parent then
				part.Transparency = value
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function restoreTransparency()
		for part, originalValue in pairs(originalTransparency) do
			if part and part.Parent then
				part.Transparency = originalValue
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function stopFlying()
		if flightConnection then
			flightConnection:Disconnect()
			flightConnection = nil
		end
	
		restoreTransparency()
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	end
	
	local function startFlying()
		local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not rootPart then return end
	
		saveTransparency()
		setTransparency(0.5)
	
		local flySpeed = 50
		local currentVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		local targetVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

		flightConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
			if not rootPart or not rootPart.Parent then
				stopFlying()
				return
			end
	
			local inputDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
				inputDirection = inputDirection + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
				inputDirection = inputDirection + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)

local function ZJKLD_script() 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Notifylable)

	local button = script.Parent
	
	local mainLabel = button:WaitForChild("MainLable")
	local secondLabel = button:WaitForChild("SecondLable")
	local rejoinButton = button:WaitForChild("Rejoin")
	local closeButton = button:WaitForChild("Close")
	
	button.Visible = false
	rejoinButton.Visible = false
	closeButton.Visible = false
	
	local targetColor = Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 127)
	
	local function monitorRewards()
		while true do
			pcall(function()
				local rewardFrame = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.MainGui.RewardFrame.Rewards
	
				if not rewardFrame then
					return
				end
	
				local targetFrame = rewardFrame:FindFirstChild("10") or 
					rewardFrame:FindFirstChild("10Frame") or
					rewardFrame:WaitForChild("10", 1)  
	
				if not targetFrame then
					
					for _, child in pairs(rewardFrame:GetChildren()) do
					end
					return
				end
	
				local frameColor = targetFrame.BackgroundColor3
				local colorDifference = math.abs(frameColor.R - targetColor.R) + 
					math.abs(frameColor.G - targetColor.G) + 
					math.abs(frameColor.B - targetColor.B)
	
				if colorDifference < 0.01 then  
					button.Visible = true
					mainLabel.Text = "Rewards"
					secondLabel.Text = "All rewards are ready! You can rejoin to farm more!"
					rejoinButton.Visible = true
					closeButton.Visible = true
				end
			end)
			wait(1)  
		end
	end
	
	rejoinButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId)
	end)
	
	closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		button.Visible = false
	end)
	
	spawn(monitorRewards)
end
